nativeFields.scope: Full shared official bond/tax conditions and native date header

conditions: Both bond fields must be approved before any new bond issuance or replacement tax.
If either fails, current1%tax and existing bonding authority remain.
Seven-eighths net allocation solely debt; taxportion expires lastdayofquarter in which bonds/refunding bonds repaid.
One-eighth taxportion does not expire; supports SystemImprovements/otherCityfacilities operation/maintenance and debt.
Replacement1% begins dayafter current2015taxexpires; no fixedcalendar date inferred.
